subject: Renaming Finalists and Public Participation Process
overview: The committee finalized a list of 18 candidates for the renaming of the Columbus School and approved a community survey process to gather public input. The body debated the fairness of its rubric system and established a subcommittee to draft the engagement form.

items.title: Administrative Business and Minutes
items.summary: The committee approved the minutes of the previous meeting and instructed members to sign and return Open Meeting Law acknowledgment packets.

items.title: Reinstatement of Omitted Candidate
items.summary: Approved adding Arthur Dello Russo to the finalist list after it was determined the name was mistakenly removed during the initial vetting process.

items.title: Resolution on Selection Methodology
items.summary: A proposal to have members submit three personal top picks from the entire submission pool was withdrawn after members argued it would bypass the established rubric process.

items.title: Public Participation Survey Resolution
items.summary: Approved a resolution to issue a one-week public survey soliciting persuasive statements of up to 250 words regarding the 18 finalists.

items.title: Amendment on Survey Eligibility
items.summary: The committee rejected an amendment that would have restricted survey participation strictly to Medford residents and Columbus School employees.

items.title: Survey Drafting Subcommittee
items.summary: Formed a subcommittee to draft the public input form for administrative review and publication on the district website.

items.title: Student Involvement and Election Proposal
items.summary: Tabled a proposal to hold a student election at the Columbus School until the committee narrows the finalist list further.
